metadata.title: When I clicked by accident and Valorant said ‘Yeah, this kill’s yours’
metadata.description:
Didn’t even mean to shoot but hey, 1 kill happened.
Enemy probably uninstalling to question their life choices.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the game still gives freebies.
Watch me pretend this was all skill for a sec.

Tap if you’ve ever snatched a kill you didn’t deserve!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
